author: human
text: HAI core should not depend on any file or folder outside .hai/ and .hai_env/ folders. The current workspace is the place where HAI is developed, but when installed on another machine, the files and folders outside .hai/ won't be installed. There is a misinterpretation now and for example HAI has in its instructions to rely on skills and roles in its workspace root folder. When .hai_env/ is installed in another workspace - it could have configured some workspace specific additional locations, but this is a custom configuration for this workspace, not a fixed dependency. Make a full review and identify all places where this issue appears.
